authorization: 2026-10-24 America/Chicago: user authorizes four parallel GPU experiments, 1,500,000 steps each; common Transformer backbone and original initialization/candidate/merge mechanisms, not the full Sudoku-specific InfiLoop architecture.
question: Train the invariant carry with one terminal supervised-token-mean loss, independent per-sequence Poisson depth and full backpropagation.

input_origin.reuse: Exact existing 40000-example world and 43000-query panels used by every DiscoLoop/gate multi-hop arm

paired_recipe.note: Every arm's backbone at step 0 must equal the reused ungated DiscoLoop's step-0 model; handoff parameters are created without consuming the global RNG.

primary: EMA R8 full-pool answer accuracy; also EMA R4/R16 and final raw/EMA R4/R8/R16/R32. Equal steps/exposure, not equal FLOPs.

loss.normalization: sum CE over all valid supervised tokens / total valid tokens in the logical batch
loss.execution: sample independent depths first; advance the full batch; freeze h/N/D/p at each endpoint without detach; one backward, clip and update
loss.current_data: one answer token and one EOS token per sample; no separate category weights

architecture_scope.common: GPT2 shared block, width768, heads12, one layer, tied embeddings/readout, causal attention, dropout0.1
architecture_scope.invariant: Latest embedding-first, invariant scorer, decoded feedback and normalized history
architecture_scope.loop: Carry raw block output; first input e; no per-round e injection
architecture_scope.discoloop: Paper symbolic-task fixed alpha=1, tau=1; add RMS-normalized soft embedding only between active rounds; read raw final block output
architecture_scope.infiloop: User-approved single-stream common-backbone adaptation: fixed random initial_h buffer, scored initial N/D, raw F(h+e) candidate, original content query/RMS score and learned beta; no DiscoLoop feedback or candidate normalization; original outer reset is no_grad
